column1: Executive Management Committee (EXCOM),Assets and Liabilities Committee ALCO

The Committee meets regularly and at least monthly to
discuss:
- strategy formulation and implementation;
- policy and procedure formulation for appropriate
internal control;
- financial performance against the approved strategy
and budgets; and
- compliance with the regulatory framework and
guidelines and adherence to Group policies and
procedures.
The Committee also serves as a link between the Board
and Management in ensuring that the Board is apprised
of key matters affecting the running of the Group.,"The Committee meets monthly or more frequently
depending on the business circumstances to:
- ensure that all foreseeable funding commitments
can be met as and when they fall due
- review and manage operational risks pertaining to
interest rate, market and exchange rate risks
governing liquidity, cash ratio and foreign

The Committee provides a source of key information
that informs considerations at Executive Management
Committee and Board Executive and Strategy
